rows.responsibility: Call media settings: global and call-specific device selection/fallback, microphone testing, camera preview, permission recovery, incoming-call authorization and system-settings routing
rows.upstream_owner: Telegram calls settings section + media devices + authorization API
rows.state_machine: enumerate devices -> resolve default/current IDs -> persist global/call-specific selection; microphone permission -> live level test -> teardown; camera preview -> suspend/cancel while current call/group call owns capture -> resume; current authorization reload -> calls-disabled-here toggle -> server reconciliation
rows.side_effects: Persists canonical audio/camera preferences, opens OS permission/audio settings, owns temporary microphone/camera test lifetimes, and mutates the current authorization incoming-call flag. No second call/media/session owner is allowed.
rows.failure_cases: inactive device treated as active; default fallback diverges; permission denial loops; mic tester survives section exit; camera preview competes with active call/group call; stale device switch targets replaced capture; authorization toggle diverges from server/current account; inaccessible radio/device chooser
rows.ui_disposition: Reuse canonical Settings/ListRow/Radio/Switch/Dialog/Button media controls with keyboard/focus/a11y/light-dark/responsive state evidence; device chooser and preview are projections of canonical media owners.
rows.fabushi_canonical_owner: Canonical call media/device settings + platform permission adapter + account-scoped authorization/session owner
rows.fabushi_target: MAPPED OPEN. Extend existing source-neutral settings/media/authorization owners; no Telegram Calls settings runtime.
rows.platform_differences: Qt/WebRTC UI helpers map to existing browser/Electron mediaDevices and native platform permission adapters; server authorization truth remains account-scoped.
rows.production_evidence: Exact source read proves responsibilities only. Existing media-device settings are partial; incoming-call authorization/current-call preview fencing and same-head evidence remain open.
rows.test_evidence: HIGH risk: unit/contract/integration/fault/security/a11y/E2E for device hotplug/inactive fallback, permission deny/grant, teardown cancellation, active-call preview exclusion, authorization reconciliation, keyboard/focus and responsive/light-dark required.

rows.license_and_provenance: telegramdesktop/tdesktop provenance retained; no source-named call settings owner retained.
